pages.text: $(4)$(l)Spoiler!$()$(br2)This entry gives away a puzzle solution. Turn the page only if you want to see it.

$(li)Myrmex clover patches spawn only in the Cherry Blossom Grove biome.$(li)The Myrmex dimension is laggy, so don't linger there. If you summon the Myrmex Queen, kill her: left alive she causes lots of lag.
$(li)Myrmex structures include one yielding Myrmite, one or two with biome focus, and others providing Myrmex Resin (useful for Soul Accumulators).
$(li)Do not automate astral water production early; wait until after completing Pixonia and acquiring celestial crystals and whispering starlight.
$(li)Pixon mobs die instantly when scoped with a Stone Bowl—even with Regeneration III—so regeneration upgrades are unnecessary for survival in this context.
$(li)To start mythic replicators, make 4–8 stacks of garnets using the mythic assembler (via fuel fragments) or wormhole EMC conversion—1 bucket of each fuel yields a full stack of garnets.

$(li)Use Arcane Bellows on an Infernal Furnace to speed up Heart of Pixonia production and increase meat nugget yield; automate by using a comparator on a chest to detect output fullness and disable the Carminite Empowerer when output space is insufficient for 8 items.
$(li)Pixon mobs can be duplicated using a Mob Duplicator (from Create), but manual right-clicking is still required to initiate duplication; fully automatic farms are not viable.
